::: {#exr-cyclone-score-fn}
#### Score function of the dataset

Derive the [score function](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) for the dataset.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-cyclone-score-fn}

The score function is the first derivative of the log-likelihood
from @exr-sample-llik:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score(\rate; \vx)
&\eqdef \deriv{\rate}\paren{\paren{\sumin \rvar_\iobs}\logf{\rate} - n\rate - \sumin \logf{\rvar_\iobs!}}
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \rvar_\iobs}\deriv{\rate}\logf{\rate} - n\deriv{\rate}\rate - \deriv{\rate}\sumin \logf{\rvar_\iobs!}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \rvar_\iobs}\frac{1}{\rate} - n - 0
&& \text{(derivatives of $\log \rate$, $\rate$, and a constant)}\\
&= \frac{n \bar x}{\rate} - n
&& \text{($\textstyle\sumin \rvar_\iobs = n \bar x$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For the cyclone data, $n = `r n`$ and $n \bar x = `r sumx`$,
so $\score(\rate; \vx) = `r sumx`/\rate - `r n`$.

:::
